summary.text: SECURE PRACTICE AS is a private limited company registered in Trondheim, founded 2017-08-01. SECURE PRACTICE AS develops and sells software and training materials to combat fraud and hacking, offers secure digital services, and provides related consulting services. Its main industry code is 62.100: computer programming activities. The register shows 13 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 11 412 988 NOK and the annual result was -127 111 NOK; operating income was up from 10 020 121 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 3 367 846 NOK in 2024 to -127 111 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 8 458 887 NOK in 2024 to 8 331 777 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is securepractice.no, which links to its LinkedIn, Vimeo profiles. Its website links to a careers page or job board. The latest news on its own website is "Psychological safety: how your work environment shapes cybersecurity culture" from 2026-09-21. The registered employee count went from 20 on 2025-12-12 to 13 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
